utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—I’m out running errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s coming along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do—I’ll check in this afternoon with a clear update on what’s been fixed and what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Eli—I appreciate it. I’ll look for your update this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo—repair drive’s still on, right? Just tell me where to drop stuff and I’m good.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep—still on. Drop it at my porch by 6 and put a note on anything that needs a quick check.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—I’ll swing by before 6 and slap a note on anything weird.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we sure the repair drive is actually happening, and who confirmed it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think it is, but I’d want the organizer’s name before we count on it—who actually confirmed the date and pickup details?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Exactly—can we get the organizer’s name and a direct confirmation before anyone starts bringing stuff over?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, Cleo, was the repair drive this Saturday, or did I mix that up again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You’ve got it right—it’s this Saturday. I’ve got the supply list handy if you want a quick rundown.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, good, thanks, Cleo—I was sure I’d scrambled it again. Yeah, give me the quick rundown so I don’t show up with the wrong stuff.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we set anything up, can you remind me which repairs the drive is supposed to cover and when you want to run it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, right—the drive’s for basic fixes like bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture, I think. I was aiming for Saturday afternoon, if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday afternoon could work; do you want to keep it to bikes, small appliances, and wobbly furniture only, or are you thinking of adding anything else before we plan around it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive looking so far?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane—it’s coming together nicely, and a few folks from both sides of the block already dropped off tools. We could use an extra pair of hands sorting the bike parts if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—I can jump on the bike parts now. Just point me to the pile and tell me how you want them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Gus—just tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s kind of you, Sam. We could use an extra pair of hands sorting tools and setting up the folding tables.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can sort the tools and help set up the folding tables—just point me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Faye, where are they holding the repair drive, and what time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s at the school parking lot, and they’re starting at 9 in the morning. I’m planning to swing by right after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — school parking lot at 9 a.m. I’ll note that down, and I may head over a little after the start too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Quinn, I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam—folks have been dropping off tools all morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great news—if it keeps up like this, we ought to tell the Millers and Jo too so they can bring anything that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I was thinking the same, Quinn—I can swing by the Millers’ after lunch and let Jo know if I catch her out front.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rey, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and who’s bringing the tools?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know that the folding tables still need repair, and Sam said he’d bring the basic tools. I can ask around quietly if you want the rest confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please confirm what else needs fixing, and ask Sam exactly which tools he’s bringing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard they’re planning a repair drive soon, so I’ve been telling folks to keep an eye out and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, good to know—I’d only heard bits and pieces, so I’ll pass that along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’s what I’ve been saying around the block—once I hear the date, I’ll make sure everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m pulling together the repair drive schedule now, and I’d love your help lining up who can bring tools and who needs fixes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the list, if that’s alright. I’m keeping things pretty quiet lately, but I do know a few folks who can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s more than enough, Uli—thank you. If you can send me the names of the neighbors who can bring tools, I’ll handle the rest and keep it simple for you.
